Twelve Archive original or image requests and one Archive capture-index request succeeded, each attempted once and spaced at least 15 seconds apart under the coordinated lane. The lane was released after the last Veikune image request.
A source HTTP200 with an Incapsula body is classified as a challenge, not a successful original. The UN PDF empty HTTP202 response is likewise not evidence content.

Japan Embassy direct HTML, PDF and JPEG resources returned 403; failures are retained and were not bypassed. The public Assembly minutes download form returned HTML and its GET download variant exhausted redirects; neither is counted as the minutes PDF.
